We're looking for an **Engineering Manager** to lead the Gravity Core Platform team.

Gravity is Innovaccer's multi-tenant Data Activation Platform (DAP): the control-plane and data-plane infrastructure that ingests, standardizes, and governs healthcare data at scale for every product built on top of it. The Gravity Core team owns the foundation everything else is built on: tenant lifecycle and multi-tenancy, PTH (the cross-plane API gateway that handles authentication, authorization, and tenant-scoped routing for every service call), identity and access management, and the shared services and datastores that downstream Gravity teams (ETL/AI orchestration, enterprise search, AI agents) depend on to run.

*People Leadership*

* Lead, mentor, and grow a team of backend/platform engineers, owning hiring, performance management, and career development.
* Run day-to-day engineering execution: sprint planning, technical reviews, and clear stakeholder communication on progress and risk.

*Technical Roadmap & Architecture*

* Own the technical roadmap for Gravity's core platform: control plane services, compute/data plane architecture, multi-tenant isolation, and tenant lifecycle management.
* Drive design and delivery of PTH, the platform's cross-plane API gateway, including authentication, authorization, and tenant-scoped routing for every service call.

*Collaboration*

* 10+ years in software engineering, including 3+ years directly managing engineering teams.
* Strong hands-on background in distributed systems, Kubernetes, and cloud infrastructure (AWS and/or Azure).
* Experience building or operating multi-tenant SaaS platforms, API gateways, or identity/authorization systems at scale.
* A track record leading platform or infrastructure teams that other engineering teams depend on, and comfort owning uptime and reliability, not just features.
* Working knowledge of microservices architectures, event-driven systems (e.g., Kafka), and modern data infrastructure (e.g., Spark/Databricks, Snowflake, Postgres, MongoDB, Redis).
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to represent technical tradeoffs clearly to both engineers and leadership.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

* Experience in healthcare technology, with familiarity with HIPAA, FHIR, or healthcare interoperability standards.
* Experience with GitOps tooling (e.g., ArgoCD) and workflow orchestration platforms (e.g., Temporal).
* Background in secrets management, network security, and zero-trust or PrivateLink-based architectures.
* Experience operating platforms across multiple deployment models (customer-hosted, vendor-hosted, hybrid).

* **Generous Leaves:** Enjoy generous leave benefits of up to 40 days.
* **Parental Leave:** Leverage one of industry's best parental leave policies to spend time with your new addition.
* **Sabbatical:** Want to focus on skill development, pursue an academic career, or just take a break? We've got you covered.
* **Health Insurance:** We offer comprehensive health insurance to support you and your family, covering medical expenses related to illness, disease, or injury. Extending support to the family members who matter most.
* **Care Program:** Whether it's a celebration or a time of need, we've got you covered with care vouchers to mark major life events. Through our Care Vouchers program, employees receive thoughtful gestures for significant personal milestones and moments of need.
* **Financial Assistance:** Life happens, and when it does, we're here to help. Our financial assistance policy offers support through salary advances and personal loans for genuine personal needs, ensuring help is there when you need it most.

Innovaccer builds software that helps hospitals, clinics, and health insurance companies make sense of all the scattered data they deal with every day (patient records, appointments, insurance claims, lab results) and turns it into something useful and actionable.

This causes delays in scheduling, slows down doctors, and makes it harder to catch health problems early. Innovaccer's platform connects all of that data together, and increasingly, uses AI "agents" to actually do some of the manual work for healthcare teams, such as scheduling appointments, preparing insurance paperwork, or drafting clinical notes, so that staff can spend more time with patients and less time on admin work.

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

### **You Are**


You are someone who looks at a test failure and does not just log it, you dig until you understand why it happened and what it means for the next release. Scripting is not a chore for you, it is how you make repetitive work disappear so you can focus on the problems that actually need a human brain. You have spent enough time in labs or codebases to know that quality is not something you test in at the end, it is something you build into the process from the start.


Data tells you stories. When you see a trend in regression results, you do not wait for someone else to notice, you pull the thread, ask the right questions, and surface what matters. You are comfortable working across teams, translating between what verification found, what design needs to know, and what a release checklist actually requires.


You do not need years of experience to have a point of view. You know when a process is not working and you are not afraid to suggest a better way. At Synopsys, you will work on Embedded Memory IP that powers the devices people use every day, and the rigor you bring to testing and automation will directly affect whether those products ship on time and work as promised.

### **What You'll Be Doing**

* Run kickoff and release meetings across design, verification, and release teams, making sure compliance checkpoints are hit and nothing falls through the cracks
* Execute regression testing on Embedded Memory IP, catch issues before they reach customers, and track results across release cycles
* Analyze test data to spot trends, recurring failures, and process gaps that affect product quality or schedule
* Write and maintain Python and Tcl automation scripts that eliminate manual testing steps and speed up validation workflows
* Coordinate with cross\-functional teams to align on quality gates, release criteria, and issue resolution timelines
* Document test results, failure analysis, and process improvements in a way that helps the next engineer understand what happened and why

### **The Impact You Will Have**

* Ensure Embedded Memory IP on advanced process nodes ships with zero critical defects, directly affecting customer success and market readiness
* Reduce validation cycle time by automating repetitive test and data collection tasks, freeing engineers to focus on complex debug work
* Surface quality and process issues early in the development cycle, preventing costly delays and rework downstream
* Improve the reliability of regression infrastructure so teams can trust test results and make faster release decisions
* Strengthen compliance and traceability across the release process, reducing risk and audit friction
* Enable smarter decision\-making by turning raw test data into actionable insights for design and verification teams

### **What You'll Need**

* Bachelor's degree in Electronics and Communication Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field
* 2 years of experience in validation, testing, quality assurance, or a related engineering role
* Working knowledge of Python or Tcl for scripting and automation
* Ability to analyze data, identify patterns, and communicate findings clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences
* Familiarity with regression testing, release processes, or quality management systems is a plus
* Strong problem\-solving instincts and the ability to work across teams without losing track of details

### **Who You Are**

* You can look at a spreadsheet of test results and spot the one anomaly that matters, not just the loudest failure
* You write scripts that other people can actually read and modify six months later
* You are comfortable running a meeting with senior engineers and keeping it focused without being intimidated
* When a process does not make sense, you ask why before you follow it blindly
